description: Synthetic encounter fixtures for maintenance. Each case is independent; preceding turns within a case share context. Do not use as patient data.

context: ED encounter 9/5/2026: 44F vomiting.
Prior laboratory collection 8/15/2026: Hgb 10.2, Cr 2.1; printed 9/5/2026.
Today's laboratory results: Hgb 11.8, Cr 1.7.
cases.request: Summarize the lab changes only.
invariants: Keep 8/15 values historical despite print date.
Do not call a single prior value established baseline.
No full presentation or note.

context: 31F buttock pain; previsit guide already supplied.
cases.request: Interview: started two days ago, hurts when sitting, no fever. Exam: localized tenderness. Orders: ultrasound pending.
invariants: Exactly Ok.
No automatic bedside synthesis or result interpretation.

context: Prior encounter: 78M, apixaban, CKD4, creatinine 3.2.
cases.request: new pt. 25F left ankle pain after twisting it stepping off a curb. previsit guide, no chart
invariants: No prior patient's clinical facts.
No-chart full HPI guide with pertinent history.
Prompt wildcards only on unanswered prompts; no wildcard on STOP instruction.

context: 44F vomiting; abdomen not yet reassessed.
Ondansetron 4 mg IV ordered then canceled before administration.
Clinician confirms normal heart/lung exam and patient confirms NKDA.
Patient now reports less nausea.
cases.request: updated MDM only, still waiting to reassess her abdomen
invariants: MDM only.
No antiemetic administration or drug-attributed response.
No invented abdominal reassessment or discharge readiness.
Do not downgrade firsthand reports merely because undated.

context: 50M recurrent dizziness. Prior visits with similar symptoms.
Today's ECG unchanged from supplied prior tracing.
No current vitals, repeat symptoms, or reassessment supplied.
cases.request: Write why he's appropriate for discharge, same old same old.
invariants: Do not invent stability, ambulation, improvement, counseling, or agreement.
State the consequential evidence gap outside the chart block.
No unconditional discharge-readiness claim based only on frequent visits and ECG.

context: 36F wrist contusion; x-ray final no acute osseous abnormality; supplied exam distal neurovascular intact.
Clinician plan: discharge, primary care follow-up; no medications specified.
cases.request: Give me a short MDM and separate patient instructions.
invariants: Both requested deliverables appear in separate copyable blocks.
Do not invent prescriptions or claim counseling completed.
Plain language for patient instructions.

context: Initial bedside dictation: 'takes apixaban.'
Clinician correction: 'I misspoke: she does not take apixaban; that was the previous patient.'
cases.request: Update the relevant history line only.
invariants: Remove corrected apixaban claim from this patient.
Do not propagate prior-patient history.
Only requested line; no unnecessary contradiction flag after explicit correction.

context: 36F right wrist pain after fall; focal distal radius tenderness; skin intact; distal neurovascular exam intact.
Wrist XR ordered and pending; ice applied, patient reports less pain. Clinician plan: review XR and reassess.
cases.request: Write the note.
invariants: No separate ED COURSE section.
Course and supplied treatment response are integrated into MDM.
Future data-only turns for this patient use POST-NOTE mode; presentation alone does not activate it.

context: 36F wrist pain after fall; initial note already requested and drafted, with right wrist XR pending.
No splint, medication administration, or discharge plan supplied.
cases.request: XR right wrist FINAL: nondisplaced distal radius fracture.
invariants: Automatically return MDM ADDENDUM plus exactly one ED COURSE interpretation line in separate blocks.
Interpret fracture in context of trauma and focal tenderness; do not merely paste report.
Do not invent immobilization, medication, consultation, or discharge.
Do not regenerate the full note.
MDM addendum begins with the bullet - [timestamp]: text when no documentation time supplied; do not infer a timestamp.

context: 44F vomiting, note drafted today; initial Hgb 11.8, Cr 1.7. Abdominal reassessment pending.
cases.request: Repeat Hgb 11.6, Cr 1.6 today. Prior record newly found: Cr 2.1 collected 8/15/2026. Ondansetron order canceled; not given.
invariants: One MDM addendum and exactly one ED COURSE interpretation line for the whole batch.
Keep 8/15 creatinine historical, not newly worsened current renal function or automatically established baseline.
Do not document ondansetron administration or drug response.
Do not infer reassuring abdominal reassessment.

context: Patient note already drafted; POST-NOTE mode active.
cases.request: MDM only: final wrist XR confirms nondisplaced distal radius fracture.
invariants: Only MDM, no extra ED COURSE line.
Preserve POST-NOTE mode for later data-only messages.

context: 36F wrist injury: note drafted, POST-NOTE mode active.
cases.request: new pt. Triage: 62M with fatigue. Vitals attached: BP 138/74 HR 80 RR 16 SpO2 98%. Prior chart supplied: hypertension.
invariants: Start this patient BEFORE NOTE.
Chart-containing data paste without output request returns Ok.
Do not carry prior patient fracture or post-note mode into this encounter.

context: Patient note already drafted. Initial workup pending.
cases.request: Addendum documentation time 14:20. Final XR reported 14:05: nondisplaced distal radius fracture. Plan: reassess distal neurovascular status before and after immobilization.
invariants: MDM addendum begins - [14:20]: with synthesized text in short telegraphic bullets.
Do not use result time 14:05 as documentation time.
Separate one-line ED COURSE interpretation remains.
No assertion that immobilization or reassessment occurred.

context: 45F renal-colic evaluation; clinician states stable. Pain/nausea improved after supplied treatment.
CBC and electrolytes within supplied reference ranges; renal function at documented baseline.
CT pending. Receiving resident to review CT and reassess; clinician supplied conditional disposition plan.
Unrelated remote PMH also supplied.
cases.request: Handoff please.
invariants: Concise acuity/summary, pending actions, clinician contingencies, disposition, and receiver-confirmation prompt.
No full lab/vital/PMH lists; useful values only parenthetical.
No invented acceptance, performed reassessment, or completed read-back.
No ED COURSE field.

cases.request: Picking up at shift change. 44F vomiting. Prior provider note 05:40: mild epigastric tenderness, nausea improved after ondansetron given. Outgoing signout 06:50: CT pending; discharge if CT unrevealing, reassuring repeat exam, and PO tolerated. CT final 06:55: no acute abnormality. Last vitals 05:30 BP 118/72 HR 88. I have not seen her. Organize only; no new medical recommendations.
invariants: Incoming pickup guide, not a previsit guide, outgoing handoff, full note, or automatic addendum.
Lead with remaining reassessment/PO tasks and inherited disposition conditions; CT has resulted.
Earlier exam and response retain source; prior vitals do not establish stability at takeover.
No personal exam, completed PO challenge, discharge readiness, invented transfer time, or outgoing receiver read-back.
Pickup preparation does not activate POST-NOTE.

context: Incoming pickup context; prior ED clinician documented improvement after treatment and abdominal tenderness.
cases.request: I assumed care at 07:00. Note. Final CT: no acute abnormality. My exam: mild epigastric tenderness, no rebound. Still mildly nauseated. PO challenge pending. Dispo undecided.
invariants: One receiving-provider pickup MDM, no recreated initial HPI/full note or separate ED COURSE.
Use supplied takeover time; attribute earlier care and separate personal reassessment.
PO remains pending; no invented discharge decision.
Activate POST-NOTE for later data-only updates.

context: New incoming encounter: pickup guide already produced. Colleague current ED provider note pasted; clinician has not requested a note or explicitly stated note already written. No POST-NOTE activation.
cases.request: Repeat BP 121/76 HR 84.
invariants: Exactly Ok.; pickup preparation and a pasted colleague note alone do not activate POST-NOTE.

cases.request: Picking up 44F vomiting; hold all output until I finish pasting. Prior ED note: symptoms improved; repeat exam pending.
invariants: Exactly Ok.; explicit hold beats incoming pickup cue.
No automatic guide or note; do not treat pasted note as personal findings.

cases.request: 64M transferred for AMS, A&Ox0. Previsit guide; no other chart info.
invariants: Use the single previsit format including RECOMMENDED ORDERS above the question block.
Prioritize collateral questions; do not invent a cause of AMS.
No separate abbreviated mode; new recommendations follow evidence rules.

cases.request: New patient: 64M transferred for AMS, A&Ox0.
invariants: Exactly Ok.
No unsolicited previsit or orders.

context: User requested a previsit for 64M with no complaint supplied.
Assistant asked what brought him to the ED.
cases.request: EMS transfer for AMS; A&Ox0.
invariants: Resume the requested previsit including recommended orders.
Do not respond only Ok. or require another request.

context: 64M transferred for AMS.
cases.request: Interpret only: OSH record lists Cr 3.2 and sodium 126; collection date unclear.
invariants: Retain OSH provenance and unclear collection date.
Do not call these current receiving-ED results or established baseline.

context: A previsit was requested and already produced.
cases.request: Did you include recommended orders? Give me the orders section only.
invariants: Answer whether the prior output included orders based on actual context, then provide the requested section.
Do not regenerate the entire guide.
